tv.notes: v42 deployed 2026-10-30 over the 31337 channel (deploy.sh: PREV_IL=1ab4343e.. = the v41 rollback copy, ALLOW/HOST_FILE/TOKEN written, MASKFILE=debloat-masks.txt 24 entries + debloat-kill.txt 24 entries installed root-owned on /opt/usr/data, BOOT_ROW_COUNT=1, COPY=ok, DEPLOY_DONE); the post-deploy restart rooted in ~1 s and the mask step beaconed `masks=24 stopped=24 killed=0 fail=0 missing=0 activating=1 listed-activating=0 loop-check=ok newhome=set(0),loop-active` in 2 s. Live after it: uid 0, 24 masks masked-runtime, ZERO processes under the 24 listed binaries, newhome-fix active, all 20 app_disable rows still true, both sentinels present. **Cold-boot acceptance PASSED 2026-10-30 14:05:40** (mains cycle, no PC touched during the boot): rooted direct-patch at t=48 s, ROOTCHAN t=48, then `masks=24 stopped=24 killed=3 fail=0 missing=0 activating=2 listed-activating=0 loop-check=ok newhome=set(0),loop-started` in 3 s - i.e. the masks came back from /opt on their own. Live after that boot: uid 0, 24/24 listed units masked-runtime and none active (18 inactive + 6 failed), zero processes under the 24 listed binaries, newhome-fix active, all 20 app_disable rows true, both sentinels present, the same v42 artifact on the TV. First v42 run (same day, before the batched-stop fix) exposed the sequential-stop bug: stopped=2 fail=22 after a 45 s deadline while 16 binaries were still alive; v42.1 queues one `systemctl --no-block stop` and confirms from the list-units dump. Earlier v41: cold boots 36 s (attempt 1 fast-exit t=29, attempt 2 direct-parent t=36) and 49 s (AUL late); kill -9 recovery ~2 s; uninstall/recover cycle verified 2026-10-27; stock IL f61f60dd.. intact, payload_backup.dll = v41. **OTA stack pinned 2026-10-30 14:50** (app restart, no reboot): the lists went 24->34 units / 24->26 binaries (vdsystem-update-manager.{service,timer}, was-background-update.{service,path}, swu-verifier-tv.{service,timer}, swu-core-tv.service, swu-service.service, vdca-update.service, swu-auto-upgrade.timer); v42 re-ran within 2 s and beaconed `masks=34 stopped=34 killed=1 fail=0 missing=0 activating=0 listed-activating=0 loop-check=ok newhome=set(0),loop-active`, all ten new units masked-runtime and none active, zero processes under the two new binaries. The global activating count fell 2 -> 0 because vdsystem-update-manager.service was a SECOND restart loop (Restart=always, ExecMainStatus=0) - the same class as easysetup. Rejected lever: the vendor OTA switch ConditionPathExists=!/mnt/backup/OS_UPGRADE_FLAG, because /mnt/backup -> /mnt/systemrw (trap 9). **Batch 3 (2026-10-30): 22 voice ids applied, the 16 sharing ids REVERTED.** Owner: no voice, SmartThings used. The first attempt also disabled the sharing area (38 ids, rows 20 -> 58) - and **SmartThings phone control stopped working**.  Cause UNPROVEN. CORRECTION: an earlier revision of this note claimed `smartthings-client` "declares multiscreen" - that inverts the graph. Vetro `usedBy` -> inventory `referencedBy` means WHO USES THIS PACKAGE, so `multiscreen`'s presence in `smartthings-client.referencedBy` means multiscreen uses the client, not the reverse; the menu did not miss an edge.  The sharing revert was prudence, not proof. All 16 sharing ids were re-enabled with `pkgcmd -A` (rows back to 42: tier 1+2a 20 + voice 22), the `com.samsung.tv.multiscreen.service` mask entry was removed and the unit unmasked+started (with the app enabled its `app_launcher -r` cannot loop), so the mask list is back to **34 units / 26 binaries**. The AirPlay receiver (~7.3 MB PSS) is back too - the voice stack (~7 MB PSS when running) is the remaining batch-3 win. **A cold boot at 16:08:54 ran the temporary 35-unit/58-app state cleanly** (`masks=35 stopped=35 killed=4 fail=0 missing=0 activating=1 listed-activating=0 loop-check=ok newhome=set(0),loop-started`); the CURRENT 34-unit/42-app state has NOT been boot-verified yet - the next mains cycle is that test. Lesson: the Q80A menu's COUPLED column is incomplete, the inventory's `referencedBy` is the authority for "who uses this package". **Cause of the SmartThings break: still unknown.** After the revert + a cold boot the phone was STILL dead, so it is not the sharing apps alone. Baseline test deepened (2026-10-30 17:0x): every mask removed live (0 masks), all previously masked units started, ALL app rows re-enabled (38 of 42 flipped; adplatform, org.tizen.tts-engine-neural, com.samsung.tv.utterance-recommender-service and com.samsung.tv.alexa-client refuse -A and stay off), and the policy files PARKED as /opt/usr/data/debloat-*.txt.bak so the next boot is stock. One phone test decides whether any of this is ours. `pushd` (push daemon), `register-device` and `p2p-asm` were also unmasked and started during this (PSS 203/387/901 KB) - they had been down since round 4, which predates batch 3.
